decision.observation: Viewed all 120 final corrected native frames, all four full-frame sheets, temporal overview, native first frame, all 120 badge crops, all 120 sewn-face crops and actual original-pixel comparisons. The same original S29 badge artwork is registered onto its own existing badge and tracked through the complete source; its original round open eyes, irises, gold round glasses and face proportions are retained. The plush uses its own initially open sewn expression tracked on the same face, removing the observed generated blink. No visible halo, double rim, face-neck seam, floating print or sliding badge appears in the reviewed frames. The original single bag, plush, rope, bollard, empty harbor boats, working buildings, gray sky and water remain, with gentle continuous water and boat motion. No real human face, person, silhouette, body part, reflection, new prop, text or cut. Original sources and both rejected versions are retained. This is video compositing of existing artwork, not newly generated eyes. All five source seconds reviewed; final uses four. Source-only assistant review, no final film or later 2K acceptance.
